about_the_game:
You have to go through this difficult path from a beginner to a seasoned stalker and uncover the mystery of your own father's disappearance!
T.D.Z. 4 The Heart of Pripyat is a game that will draw you in with its amazing atmosphere from the first seconds! Gray sky, rain, campfire dialogues with loyal stalker friends, mutants, anomalies are just a small part of what awaits you in this 1st-person action-adventure shooter! Explore the abandoned locations of the mysterious Exclusion Zone, shoot back mutants, search caches of ammunition and food, complete tasks of stalker friends and reach the very Pripyat to see the finale of this amazing story!
►Game Features◄
☢️ Freedom of action! You can explore the stunning beauty of the location, as well as complete the tasks of other stalkers, earning new equipment!
☢️ A large selection of items! 7 types of weapons, bolts, grenades, first aid kits, anomaly detectors, food and much more in your arsenal for survival in a dangerous zone!
☢️ A mixture of genres in one bottle! Horror, Survival, Action Shooter in one game and at once!
☢️ Convenient controls will appeal to everyone!
☢️ Stunning graphics!
☢️ Dynamic storyline!
